an4.35:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
an4.35:1.2: atha kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
an4.35:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an4.35:2.1: catūhi kho mayaṃ bho gotama, dhammehi samannāgataṃ mahāpaññaṃ mahāpurisaṃ paññapema.
an4.35:2.3: idha bho gotama, bahussuto hoti tassa tasseva sutajātassa.
an4.35:2.4: tassa tasseva kho pana bhāsitassa atthaṃ jānāti ‘ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho, ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho’ti.
an4.35:2.5: satimā kho pana hoti cirakatampi cirabhāsitampi saritā anussaritā.
an4.35:2.6: yāni kho pana tāni gahaṭṭhakāni kiṅkaraṇīyāni, tattha dakkho hoti, analaso, tatrūpāyāyavīmaṃsāya samannāgato alaṃ kātuṃ alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ.
an4.35:2.7: imehi kho mayaṃ bho gotama, catūhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ mahāpaññaṃ mahāpurisaṃ paññapema.
an4.35:2.8: sace pana me bho gotama, anumoditabbaṃ, anumodatu me bhavaṃ gotamo.
an4.35:2.9: sace pana me bho gotama, paṭikkositabbaṃ, paṭikkosatu me bhavaṃ gotamoti.
an4.35:3.1: neva kho tyāhaṃ brāhmaṇa, anumodāmi. na paṭikkosāmi.
an4.35:3.2: catūhi kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa, dhammehi samannāgataṃ mahāpaññaṃ mahāpurisaṃ paññapemi.
an4.35:3.4: idha brāhmaṇa, bahujanahitāya paṭipanno hoti bahujanasukhāya
an4.35:3.5: bahu’ssa janatā ariye ñāye patiṭṭhāpitā, yadidaṃ kalyāṇadhammatā kusaladhammatā.
an4.35:3.6: so yaṃ vitakkaṃ ākaṅkhati vitakketuṃ. taṃ vitakkaṃ vitakketi. yaṃ vitakkaṃ nākaṅkhati vitakketuṃ, na taṃ vitakkaṃ vitakketi.
an4.35:3.7: yaṃ saṅkappaṃ ākaṅkhati saṅkappetuṃ, taṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappeti. yaṃ saṅkappaṃ nākaṅkhati saṅkappetuṃ, na taṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappeti.
an4.35:3.9: catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
an4.35:3.10: āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an4.35:3.11: neva kho tyāhaṃ brāhmaṇa, anumodāmi. na pana paṭikkosāmi.
an4.35:3.12: imehi kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa, catūhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ mahāpaññaṃ mahāpurisaṃ paññāpemīti.
an4.35:4.1: acchariyaṃ bho gotama. abbhutaṃ bho gotama.
an4.35:4.3: imehi ca mayaṃ catūhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ dhārema.
an4.35:4.4: bhavaṃ hi gotamo bahujanahitāya paṭipanno bahujanasukhāya,
an4.35:4.5: bahu te janatā ariye ñāye patiṭṭhāpitā yadidaṃ kalyāṇadhammatā kusaladhammatā.
an4.35:4.6: bhavaṃ hi gotamo yaṃ vitakkaṃ ākaṅkhati vitakketuṃ, taṃ vitakkaṃ vitakketi. yaṃ vitakkaṃ nākaṅkhati vitakketuṃ, na taṃ vitakkaṃ vitakketi. yaṃ saṅkappaṃ ākaṅkhati saṅkappetuṃ, taṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappeti. yaṃ saṅkappaṃ nākaṅkhati saṅkappetuṃ, na taṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappeti.
an4.35:4.7: bhavaṃ hi gotamo cetovasippatto vitakkapathesu. bhavaṃ
an4.35:4.8: hi gotamo catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
an4.35:4.9: bhavaṃ hi gotamo āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti.
an4.35:5.1: addhā kho te brāhmaṇa, āsajja upanīyavācā bhāsitā.
an4.35:5.4: bahu me janatā ariye ñāye patiṭṭhāpitā, yadidaṃ kalyāṇadhammatā kusaladhammatā.
an4.35:5.5: ahaṃ hi brāhmaṇa, yaṃ vitakkaṃ ākaṅkhāmi vitakketuṃ, taṃ vitakkaṃ vitakkemi. yaṃ vitakkaṃ nākaṅkhāmi vitakketuṃ, na taṃ vitakkaṃ vitakkemi. yaṃ saṅkappaṃ ākaṅkhāmi saṅkappetuṃ, taṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappemi. yaṃ saṅkappaṃ nākaṅkhāmi saṅkappetuṃ, na taṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappemi.
an4.35:5.6: ahaṃ hi brāhmaṇa, cetovasippatto vitakkapathesu. ahaṃ
an4.35:5.7: hi brāhmaṇa, catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
an4.35:5.8: ahaṃ hi brāhmaṇa, āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti.
an4.35:6.5: yaṃ ve disvā ca sutvā ca
